scope: Current-session shared-service loading cleanup after cancellation
rationale: Track loading-enabled Axios request configs within the current session epoch.
Remove only the settled current request and publish whether other loading-enabled work remains.
Reset bookkeeping when session ownership changes. Ignore stale response loading mutations.
Keep authentication, credential validation, cancellation rejection, and error handling rules unchanged.
affected_paths: Successful response interceptor, including fresh login epoch changes
Shared loading boolean used by PageLoader
qualitative_risk: Shared state, concurrency, and session replacement require preservation assertions.

DEL-21: Given session A has a held loading-enabled request
When a second request with show-loading=false starts
When the silent request returns HTTP200 and silent-position
Then its caller receives that response and loading remains true
When the first request is canceled
Then it rejects ERR_CANCELED and loading becomes false
And session A token and empty error remain unchanged
DEL-22: Given session A has a held loading-enabled request
When session ownership changes to B and a B request starts
When the old A request is canceled
And loading remains true with token session-b and empty error
When B returns HTTP200 and current-position
Then its caller receives that response and loading becomes false

limits: This patch exists only in the isolated checkout.
